title_en: Check Out All the Winners of the 3rd Annual DevGamm Awards
summary_en: The 3rd annual DevGAMM Awards took place today, November 18, in Lisbon, Portugal, and celebrated 70 nominated games from 25 countries across 17 award categories. You can check out all of the winners right here, including Phonopolis, the game that led the way by securing both the Grand Prize and Excellence in Visual Art award.
body_en:
The 3rd annual DevGAMM Awards took place today, November 18, in Lisbon, Portugal, and celebrated 70 nominated games from 25 countries across 17 award categories. The show streamed on IGN and can check out all of the winners below, including Phonopolis, the game that led the way by securing both the Grand Prize and Excellence in Visual Art award.
The winners were decided by an international jury of 191 industry professionals from 40 countries. Beyond simply voting, however, the judges' "expertise and thoughtful feedback offered participating teams something that lasts considerably longer than an evening of applause."
Without further ado, here are the winners of The DevGAMM Awards 2026;
Grand Prize
Excellence in Game Design
Excellence in Visual Art
Excellence in Narrative
Excellence in Audio
Best Mobile Game
Most Anticipated Game
Best Game in Early Development
Best Small Team Game
Meaningful Game
Best Game from Portugal
DevGAMM Choice
Epic Games Store Indie Spotlight
Best Unreal Engine Game
Best Indie Game by tinyBuild
Best Made With Unity Game
Best Godot Game
For more, check out all you need to know about the DevGAMM Awards on their website.
